description: Device heterogeneity is not categorized as a bias. Cross-device systematic difference is a textbook measurement_bias for multimodal imaging AI, but it appears only under anomalies, so known_biases omits a bias type that the dataset's own acquisition design makes likely.

assessment: Device heterogeneity and image-quality variation are documented outside known_biases; known_biases lacks a measurement-bias entry. Adding that taxonomy entry is an interpretive categorization improvement, not proof a source fact was omitted.
recommended_action: Consider a qualified measurement-bias entry that cites the documented device/site heterogeneity and labels the risk as an interpretation.
uncertainty: The inference from heterogeneous devices to systematic bias is not empirically tested.

recommendation: State in the description that the pediatric cohort is documented only as context and is distributed as the separate related dataset doi:10.13026/h995-bt35.
assessment: The adult-release description says participants were recruited from five categories including pediatric disorders, and collection_mechanisms includes a pediatric process. Other fields correctly identify pediatric data as a separate release. This is a supported scope-clarity problem in generated wording.
recommended_action: Revise the adult-release description to four adult disease categories plus controls; describe pediatric categories only as a separate consortium dataset.
uncertainty: The underlying adult/pediatric dataset separation is explicit in sources; no records were inspected.
